scripts.postbuild: node scripts/copy-static.mjs && node scripts/postbuild-picture.mjs && node scripts/extract-critical.mjs && node scripts/lqip-placeholders.mjs
scripts.img:convert: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem assets/images/projects -Include *.png,*.jpg,*.jpeg -Recurse | ForEach-Object { $base=$_.FullName; $webp=$base + '.webp'; $avif=$base + '.avif'; if (Get-Command cwebp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { cwebp -q 82 $_.FullName -o $webp } ; if (Get-Command avifenc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { avifenc --min 20 --max 28 --speed 6 $_.FullName $avif } }"
